statement: RUM Group disclosed financing challenges in August and there is doubt its Georgia data center will meet a late-2026 completion target, putting delivery of the Anthropic contract at risk.
why: Committed compute only becomes real demand if the counterparty can finance and build; shaky provider financing is the classic failure point in these deals.

impact.mechanism: A provider with disclosed financing difficulties may not raise the capital to buy accelerators and complete the site, delaying or voiding the contracted capacity.

evidence.excerpt: the company disclosed financing challenges in August, and there is doubt the Georgia data center will meet its projected completion timeline of late 2026

confidence.basis: Single secondary outlet; the risk is described qualitatively with no financing terms or covenant detail.
